title: A GTA 6 leaker says they'll release a full playable build of the game - but only if their cryptocurrency coin reaches a market cap of $30m
summary: GTA 6 leaker CyberLeek has reportedly threatened to release a complete playable build, and wants Take-Two to release the game physically.

Image credit: Rockstar Games News by Vikki Blake Contributor Published on Oct. 10, 2026, 7:42 p.m. Follow Grand Theft Auto VI Prioritise us on Google A GTA 6 leaker has reportedly threatened to put out a complete, playable build of the game, start to finish. The threat was posted on CyberLeek's website after the leaker shared 25 minutes of footage from the game earlier this week. To see this content please enable targeting cookies. Manage cookie settings GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto 6) - Official Extended Gameplay. Watch on YouTube Rockstar has previously issued statements regarding the leaker, noting that the leaks are "heartbreaking" and that "this is obviously not how we intended for you to see the game after all this time". Take-Two, Rockstar's parent company, has been hunting for the person behind the leaks, and has tried to subpoena Discord for information pertaining to the leaker's identity. After going quiet for a bit, CyberLeek came back with a bang this week, posting new footage from Rockstar's upcoming game that even features nude scenes, including a fully naked Jason, and a topless Lucia. Eurogamer has seen the video, and it appears to be legitimate - and, as is now traditional, has CyberLeek's emblem overlaid on top of the footage. CyberLeek now reportedly says the build will go out if their cryptocurrency coin reaches a market cap of $30 million, and claims it can be played through to the end credits. "Here's the deal, nice and clean," the demand reads. "CyberLeek hits 30 million marketcap, the build goes out - full story mode, played to the end, credits and all. Don't believe it has full story mode? Ask for what you want to see, and it gets provided. Take-Two gets one way out: physical disks and a public apology. They can take it at any moment. Or they can gamble that CL is bluffing. Everyone knows which one they'll pick." GTA 6 is due out on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on 19th November.
